svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Component · Output approval · video · narrow
svg.desc: Mirrors GalleryPreviewPanel.sourceApprovalRow (App/GalleryPreviewPanel.swift, 2026-11-05; docs/approved-assets.md) — the project's own approval, under Output's buttons in both dresses, for a Photo capture (the picture as the editor shows it: it follows the edits) or a video (the source clip as it is). Never for an interval shoot, whose source is frames, nor a scan. One button, the whole row: HStack(alignment: .top, spacing: 10) of the seal (17 pt medium in a 22 pt column — checkmark.seal in secondary at rest, checkmark.seal.fill in LL.accent once approved), the title 14 pt semibold over the caption 11.5 pt secondary (2 apart, wrapping in a 236 pt column: 302 − 24 padding − 22 − two 10 pt gaps), padded 12 × 9 on primary at 6 % — LL.accent at 10 % once approved, the title then reading Approved in LL.accent — radius 9. Height = 9 + 17 + 2 + 14 per caption line + 9. A press toggles (model.setApproved). THIS STATE: a video with edits, source not approved — the caption says the edits are not in the source. With no edits the caption is one line, “Clears the clip, as it is, for use.” (51 pt tall, not drawn). 65 pt tall. See components/README.md.

g.text: Clears the clip as shot — your edits are not
in it. Render Edits first for the graded one.
